spans.s: लोच् (I) vt. 1Ā (pres. लोचते) To see, to behold, to view, to perceive.
लोच् Caus. (लोचयति-ते) to cause to see.With आ-, 1. to know, to understand, e.g.

लोचक m. 1. A stupid person; 2. the pupil of the eye; 3. collyrium; 4. a kind of ornament worn on the forehead by women; 5. a lump of flesh; 6. a blue garment; 7. an earring; 8. the plantain tree; 9. the slough of a tree; 10. a wrinkled skin; 11. a. bowstring.
लोचन n. 1. Seeing, looking, viewing; 2. the eye, स्फुरदधरसीधवे तव वदनचंद्रमा रोचयति लोचनचकोरम् Git.G.x., R.i.73, ii.19, iii.41, Megh.i.16, 27.
लोचन-गोचर, -पथ, -मार्ग m. the range of the eyes.
